annotations.title: Upload a screenshot to a store

description: Uploads one image (PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB, from an absolute path on this machine) straight to the store listing. apple types: APP_IPHONE_67 (6.9-inch iPhone, required), APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129 (13-inch iPad), and Apple's other display types; only on a version being prepared. google types: phoneScreenshots (2 to 8), sevenInchScreenshots, tenInchScreenshots, featureGraphic (1024×500, one), and for a Wear OS or TV app wearScreenshots (square, 384 px or more), tvScreenshots (16:9 landscape, 1280×720 or more) and tvBanner (1280×720, one). The file is checked against the store's rules first (ploa_screenshot_specs, ploa_screenshot_check) and refused with the reasons if the store wouldn't take it. Screenshots go after the ones already in the set: upload in the order they should appear. After an upload that failed (a 502, a timeout), read ploa_listing_get before trying again, since the first one may have arrived; fix the order with ploa_screenshot_order (App Store). Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
